verdict.rationale: Docusign has a substantial programmatic surface: the eSignature REST API, an official Node.js SDK for sending, signing and approving, published OpenAPI/Swagger specs, and an official MCP server for querying agreements and triggering IAM workflows. Community reports confirm production embedded-signing integrations work well. However, nothing in the evidence claims or shows API parity with the UI. Several products are pitched as UI-first (drag-and-drop CLM process design; web forms built with 'clicks, not code'), and one hands-on report says a needed embedded-flow fix required falling back to a legacy API version. Missing for 10: any documented statement or evidence of UI/API feature parity, API coverage of the CLM and Web Forms builders and the AI review features, and independent confirmation that UI-only gaps don't exist.
